sloka: शान्तैः सर्वप्रजाकान्तैः प्रीतिसंजननैर्नृणाम् ।गुणैर्विरुरुचे रामो दीप्तः सूर्य इवांशुभिः ॥२-२-४७॥
transliteration: śāntaiḥ sarvaprajākāntaiḥ prītisaṁjananairnṛṇām ।guṇairviruruce rāmo dīptaḥ sūrya ivāṁśubhiḥ ॥2-2-47॥

translations.english: When pleased, Rama bestows wealth. Like the Sun shining with his rays, He shines with his qualities of tranquil, charming and loving nature.
